title: About "five (5) Submissions per day"
note: authorName field was empty in CLI output for all 3 messages (CLI limitation). WebFetch could not render dynamic discussion content. Ordering below is chronological by postDate.

messages.content_html:
According to the Rules, it states: “You may submit a maximum of five (5) Submissions per day.”

If a submission results in an ERROR after being submitted, does that submission still count toward the daily limit of five submissions?
messages.content_text: According to the Rules, it states: “You may submit a maximum of five (5) Submissions per day.” If a submission results in an ERROR after being submitted, does that submission still count toward the daily limit of five submissions?

messages.content_html: Error messages do not count against your submission limit in this competition. They do in prediction competitions, where errors may be able to provide information about the test set.
